title: Harness control-plane error data
description: ADR-0076 P3 contract error payloads. Declared for the frozen IDL only; no handler raises these yet.

StaleFenceData.description: ADR-0068 session fence rejected the mutation: the caller's epoch is stale.

NotInitializedData.description: A verb other than initialize arrived before the handshake completed.

QuiescentGateData.description: Admission refused while the original effect is quiescent-gated; only B(resolved) lifts the gate.

CursorInvalidData.description: A delta/settled cursor was applied to the wrong projection or epoch.
